Criterion: Conceptually sound. Focus individual. Means = "I want to ..." part. Ends = "so that ..." part. Violation if means doesn't state feature OR ends introduces another required feature instead of rationale. Sometimes "so that ..." absent? Still story has clauses.

Need be consistent with examples: 
- "I want to open city map, so that I can display all restaurant markers" = ends introduces another feature, violation.
- "I want an easy experience, so that I can reset my password" means vague, ends actual feature, violation.
- "I want to open city map, so that I can orient myself downtown" = no violation.
- "I want to reset password, so that I can regain access" no violation.
